capabilities: Sync a vault with its folder in a shared GitHub repository
Save conflicting edits alongside the original as sync-conflict files
Restore recently deleted files from a hidden sync folder
Include plugins, themes and settings in the sync with an ignore list
Sync automatically on startup and every few minutes, or manually
disambiguation: Not a full Git client; it syncs this vault only with its own folder in a shared repository and never touches other vaults' folders.
extras: The GitHub token is stored in plain text in data.json inside the synced repository; the README advises limiting the token to that one repository and keeping the repo private. Manual install requires copying main.js and manifest.json from a release.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in free way to keep several vaults in sync across devices through one Git repository without installing Git.

requires.name: GitHub fine-grained token with Contents access

summary: Syncs one Obsidian vault with its own folder in a shared GitHub repository, on desktop and Android, without a Git install.
